artifact.title: Quality Control Program — 26HH0001

tests.citation: DPWH Minimum Testing Requirements (MTR) Vol II Item 200 — aggregate subbase course (2016, tier 2) — keyed to the 2012 edition of the Standard Specifications; re-check against a current Volume II
tests.acceptance: Grading per Table 200.1 (50 mm = 100; 25 mm = 55–85; 9.5 mm = 40–75; 0.075 mm = 0–12). Fraction passing 0.075 mm not greater than 0.66 of the fraction passing 0.425 mm. Fraction passing 0.425 mm: liquid limit not greater than 35, plasticity index not greater than 12 (AASHTO T 89 / T 90).
tests.acceptanceCitation: DPWH Standard Specifications for Highways, Bridges and Airports, Volume II §200.2, Table 200.1 (2013, tier 1) — countersigned by Jayz on 2026-09-15; read from the 2013 edition held in the vault

tests.citation: DPWH Minimum Testing Requirements (MTR) Vol II Item 200 — aggregate subbase course (2016, tier 2) — keyed to the 2012 edition of the Standard Specifications; re-check against a current Volume II
tests.acceptance: Soaked CBR not less than 30% (AASHTO T 193), obtained at the maximum dry density determined by AASHTO T 180 Method D. Coarse portion retained on 2.00 mm: mass percent of wear not exceeding 50 (AASHTO T 96).
tests.acceptanceCitation: DPWH Standard Specifications for Highways, Bridges and Airports, Volume II §200.2 (2013, tier 1) — countersigned by Jayz on 2026-09-15; read from the 2013 edition held in the vault

tests.citation: DPWH Minimum Testing Requirements (MTR) Vol II Item 200 — aggregate subbase course (2016, tier 2) — keyed to the 2012 edition of the Standard Specifications; re-check against a current Volume II
tests.acceptance: Field density at least 100% of the maximum dry density determined by AASHTO T 180 Method D; in-place density determined by AASHTO T 191. Layers of more than 150 mm required thickness compacted in two or more layers, no compacted layer exceeding 150 mm.
tests.acceptanceCitation: DPWH Standard Specifications for Highways, Bridges and Airports, Volume II §200.3.3 (2013, tier 1) — countersigned by Jayz on 2026-09-15; read from the 2013 edition held in the vault
